title: Deer reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Deer body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="78" rx="22" ry="16" fill="#c97b3a"/>
  <!-- Deer chest/neck -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="58" rx="14" ry="14" fill="#e09a55"/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="40" rx="13" ry="14" fill="#e09a55"/>
  <!-- Ears -->
  <ellipse cx="36" cy="28" rx="5" ry="8" fill="#e09a55" transform="rotate(-20 36 28)"/>
  <ellipse cx="36" cy="28" rx="3" ry="5" fill="#f2b98a" transform="rotate(-20 36 28)"/>
  <ellipse cx="64" cy="28" rx="5" ry="8" fill="#e09a55" transform="rotate(20 64 28)"/>
  <ellipse cx="64" cy="28" rx="3" ry="5" fill="#f2b98a" transform="rotate(20 64 28)"/>
  <!-- Antlers -->
  <path d="M42 28 Q38 14 32 10" stroke="#a0622a" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M40 20 Q34 16 30 18" stroke="#a0622a" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M58 28 Q62 14 68 10" stroke="#a0622a" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M60 20 Q66 16 70 18" stroke="#a0622a" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <ellipse cx="45" cy="40" rx="3" ry="3.5" fill="#2a1a0a"/>
  <ellipse cx="55" cy="40" rx="3" ry="3.5" fill="#2a1a0a"/>
  <circle cx="46" cy="39" r="1" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="56" cy="39" r="1" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <!-- Nose -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="48" rx="4" ry="2.5" fill="#8a4a1a"/>
  <!-- Mouth -->
  <path d="M47 51 Q50 54 53 51" stroke="#8a4a1a" stroke-width="1.2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Arms holding book -->
  <path d="M34 68 Q38 72 42 74" stroke="#c97b3a" stroke-width="5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M66 68 Q62 72 58 74" stroke="#c97b3a" stroke-width="5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Book -->
  <rect x="34" y="66" width="32" height="20" rx="2" fill="#e84a4a"/>
  <rect x="48" y="66" width="4" height="20" fill="#c42f2f"/>
  <!-- Book pages -->
  <rect x="37" y="68" width="11" height="16" rx="1" fill="#fff6e0"/>
  <rect x="52" y="68" width="11" height="16" rx="1" fill="#fff6e0"/>
  <!-- Page lines -->
  <line x1="39" y1="71" x2="46" y2="71" stroke="#d4c4a0" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="39" y1="74" x2="46" y2="74" stroke="#d4c4a0" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="39" y1="77" x2="46" y2="77" stroke="#d4c4a0" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="54" y1="71" x2="61" y2="71" stroke="#d4c4a0" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="54" y1="74" x2="61" y2="74" stroke="#d4c4a0" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="54" y1="77" x2="61" y2="77" stroke="#d4c4a0" stroke-width="1"/>
  <!-- Book cover edges -->
  <rect x="34" y="66" width="32" height="20" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#b02a2a" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- Legs -->
  <rect x="38" y="88" width="5" height="8" rx="2" fill="#c97b3a"/>
  <rect x="57" y="88" width="5" height="8" rx="2" fill="#c97b3a"/>
  <!-- Hooves -->
  <rect x="37" y="94" width="7" height="4" rx="2" fill="#8a4a1a"/>
  <rect x="56" y="94" width="7" height="4" rx="2" fill="#8a4a1a"/>
</svg>
